headline: Public hearings on variance requests at 722 Center Street, 53 Blakeslee Road, and 1549 Tuttle Avenue, plus a special exception at 1549 Tuttle Avenue.
summary: Staff will discuss waiving application fees for the Gentile applications on Tuttle Avenue. A new DeBaise application for 45 Country Club Lane, after a denial, is also up for discussion.
items: Special exception request for 1549 Tuttle Avenue (Gentile), #26-021
Discussion of waiving application fees for #26-020 and #26-021
Discussion of a new special exception application for 45 Country Club Lane (DeBaise), after denied application #26-014, with fees waived before six months
location: Robert F. Parisi Council Chambers, Town Hall - 45 South Main Street
plain_text:
AGENDA 
Wallingford Zoning Board of Appeals 
Monday, November 16, 2026 
7:00 p.m. 
Robert F. Parisi Council Chambers 
Town Hall − 45 South Main Street 
 
 
Call to Order 
Pledge of Allegiance 
Roll Call 
 
PUBLIC HEARINGS 
 
1. #26-018 – Variance Request/McNulty/722 Center Street 
2. #26-019 – Variance Request/Akbar/53 Blakeslee Road 
3. #26-020 – Variance Request/Gentile/1549 Tuttle Avenue 
4. #26-021 – Special Exception Request/Gentile/1549 Tuttle Avenue 
  
STAFF DISCUSSION 
 
5. Discussion of waiving application fees for #26-020 – Variance Request/Gentile/1549 
Tuttle Avenue & #26-021 – Special Exception Request/Gentile/1549 Tuttle Avenue 
6. Discussion of permitting new application for Special Exception Request/DeBaise/45 
Country Club Lane (#26-014 Denied) with waived application fees prior to 6 months 
 
CONSIDERATION OF MINUTES 
 
7. October 19, 2026, Regular Meeting 
 
MEETING SCHEDULE 
 
8. Consideration of ZBA 2027 Meeting Schedule 
 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
 
 
Individuals in need of auxiliary aids for effective communications in programs and 
services of the Town of Wallingford are invited to make their needs and 
preferences known to the ADA Compliance Coordinator at 203-294-2070 five (5) 
days prior to the meeting date.
